title: A Bug in the Mud
lines: Ben and Meg dug in the mud.
Ben set the net on the big bug.
It did not tug. It sat in the net.
Ben fed it a bit of a bun.
"A bug is not a pet," said Meg.
Ben set the bug in the mud. It dug!

questions.ask: What did Ben and Meg find when they dug in the mud?
questions.listenFor: A bug. Meg spots it in line two. If your child is unsure, have them find the word bug and read that line again.

questions.ask: Why did Ben put the bug back in the mud?
questions.listenFor: Meg said a bug is not a pet. Listen for them linking what Meg said to what Ben did next - those two lines go together.

questions.ask: Find the line that shows the bug was glad to be back in the mud. Read it to me.
questions.listenFor: The last line — it dug the moment it was set down. Let them spot the word dug themselves.
